mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium as investors anticipate future rate hikes, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the triggered period, or CPIAUCSL reverts below 0.3% within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressures that prompt equity market participants to anticipate higher corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day rolling average of 60-day forward returns remains negative during the wage acceleration regime, or PAYEMS decelerates by >0.5% in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in RSAFS industrial production exceeding 2% indicates weakening domestic demand, which typically precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates softening economic activity.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls by more than 2% over two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative during the contraction, or RSAFS recovers by >2% within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly expansion in INDPRO supply index above 1.5% suggests easing supply constraints, which, when combined with falling UNRATE labor costs, amplifies investor optimism and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: AND: INDPRO increases by >1.5% AND UNRATE falls by >0.2% in the same month
regime_hint: supply loosening coupled with labor cost decline
failure_condition: 60-day rolling average of forward returns remains negative during the interaction, or either INDPRO contraction or UNRATE rise occurs in >70% of similar windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in FEDFUNDS above 5.25% in a single month, followed by two consecutive months of stability, signals the end of rate hikes and a shift toward rate-cutting expectations, which tends to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% and remains ≥5.25% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative during the post-hike stability window, or FEDFUNDS resumes rising by >0.25% in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST housing starts by more than 10% above the prior month's level, sustained for two months, is interpreted as a housing recovery signal that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >10% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative during the housing acceleration, or HOUST declines by >10% in the subsequent month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-time drop in GDPC1 personal consumption expenditures (quarter-on-quarter) of more than 3% followed by two consecutive quarters of flat or rising values is interpreted as a demand shock that tends to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls by >3% QoQ, with next two quarters ≥ flat
regime_hint: negative demand shock with persistent softening
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive during the shock window, or GDPC1 recovers >3% in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO and UNRATE move in opposite directions simultaneously—INDPRO rising by ≥0.8% while UNRATE falls by ≥0.2% in the same month—the market interprets easing supply-cost pressures and lower wage inflation, which tends to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: AND: INDPRO increases by ≥0.8% AND UNRATE decreases by ≥0.2% in the same month
regime_hint: opposing supply and labor cost trends
failure_condition: 60-day rolling average of forward returns remains negative during such opposing movements, or the pattern recurs less than 5% of the time in the sample period.
